consumer: The offline map-dump tool that reads the snapshot JSON and asks: what is the raw authoritative terrain/furniture id at each nearby tile right now?
scope: Each nearby tile's raw, ground-truth map terrain/furniture id, independent of visibility/seen state or any display filtering.
decisive_source: map::ter / map::furn (read via ctx.m.ter(p).id().str() and ctx.m.furn(p).id().str() in arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles) returns the raw map-stored terrain/furniture id at the tile, i.e. authoritative simulation state, not a computed predicate or display proxy.
divergence: A tile the player has not currently seen but previously remembered as different terrain (e.g. raw state is now t_dirt after a wall was smashed, while the GUI's remembered/displayed memory still shows t_wall): a display-class read would report the stale remembered id, whereas the raw m.ter() read correctly reports t_dirt, which is what a raw offline dump requires.
